prompt: CSS flexbox main size depends on cross size auto indefinite substitute
answer:
If a flex item’s main size depends on its cross size, and its cross size is `auto` and not definite, Flexbox uses `fit-content` as the cross size for that calculation. The resulting main size becomes the flex base size.

This applies, for example, when the main size is in the block axis or when the item has a preferred aspect ratio. [CSS Flexbox §9.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-flexbox-1/)
